caption: The drawing consists of six separate embroidered designs on a plain, light-colored background. The central piece features a bordered rectangular sampler with a poem stitched in brown thread, surrounded by decorative motifs including a brown eagle atop a pedestal, a large pink and green flower in a blue vase, a green and red parrot on a branch with blue and pink flowers, a blue vase with pink flowers, and a small brown butterfly. The surrounding five pieces are arranged symmetrically: at the top left is a brown and tan eagle perched on a brown pedestal; below it is a green and red parrot with brown, blue, and pink accents sitting on a branch; at the bottom left is a small pink and blue flower with a blue stem and green leaves; at the top right is a large symmetrical pink and green flower in a blue decorative urn; and at the bottom right is a small brown and tan object next to a green vine and a pink flower. Each embroidered piece is stitched on a neutral, coarse fabric and mounted on the page. The compositions feature a combination of geometric and natural forms, with a color palette including shades of brown, green, blue, pink, red, and tan.
title: Sampler
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
